title: Seven Floors Up
搬上七樓
paras: Priya Nair had spent three weeks planning the {{relocation|relocation}} of Brightline Design from the third floor to the seventh. She had drawn the new {{layout|layout}} : twelve desks along the windows, a small kitchen in the corner, and a {{boardroom|boardroom}} with a long table where the directors would hold their monthly meetings.
普莉亞·奈爾花了三個星期，規劃 Brightline 設計公司從三樓搬到七樓的事。她畫好新的配置圖：十二張辦公桌沿著窗邊排開，角落有間小茶水間，還有一間董事會議室，裡面的長桌是給董事開月會用的。

On Saturday morning, the {{installation|installation}} of the new {{copier|copier}} was the first job. The technician, Leo, rolled it into the hall and frowned. "There's no {{cartridge|cartridge}} in the box," he said. "Without toner, it won't print a single page." Priya remembered two spare ones in the supply closet on the old floor. She ran {{downstairs|downstairs}} and grabbed them.
週六早上，第一件事是安裝新影印機。技術人員里奧把機器推進走廊，皺起了眉頭。「箱子裡沒有碳粉匣，」他說，「沒有碳粉，一張都印不出來。」普莉亞想起舊樓層的備品櫃裡還有兩個備用的。她跑下樓去拿。

The real surprise came at five o'clock, when the elevator opened and Mr. Reyes, the evening {{cleaner|cleaner}}, stepped out with his cart. "I went to the third floor, but it's empty," he said. Priya's stomach dropped. She had forgotten to {{notify|notify}} the cleaning company about the move.
真正的意外發生在五點，電梯門一開，晚班清潔工雷耶斯先生推著他的推車走了出來。「我去了三樓，結果整層都空了，」他說。普莉亞心頭一沉。她忘了通知清潔公司搬家的事。

"I'm so sorry," she said. "And this floor is covered in construction dust." Mr. Reyes smiled. "Give me two hours." He pulled a {{vacuum|vacuum}} off his cart and went to work. By seven, the floors were spotless. On Monday morning, the team walked in, and nobody guessed how close the week had come to a mess.
「真的很抱歉，」她說，「而且這層到處都是裝潢留下的灰塵。」雷耶斯先生笑了笑。「給我兩個小時。」他從推車上抽出一台沉重的吸塵器，動手開工。到了七點，地板乾淨得發亮。週一早上，同事們走進來，沒人知道這一週差一點就一團亂。
